title: A quick review/praise for L'Argent and Bresson.

commenti.body: Have you seen The Devil, Probably? Also by Bresson, and has many of the same themes; individuals feeling (or being) abandoned by society and then engaging in self-destructive behaviors (as you put it, sin) resulting in terrible consequences
I was weighing wether to watch that one or L'Argent on Criterion Channel. You suggestion makes it an easy choice to watch in the near future.
